notes.title: Nominate Potion Permit for Steam's Labour of Love Award!
notes.content:
Hey Potion Brewers, 

We are thrilled to announce that you can now nominate Potion Permit for Steam's Labour of Love Award. 

We're immensely proud of the journey we've taken together since the game's launch, doing our best to update and improve the game, providing you with a richer experience. From cute mini-games to new datable characters and a plethora of exciting features, we've poured our hearts and souls into Potion Permit.


[h2]Added datable characters[/h2]
One of our most exciting updates to Potion Permit has been the introduction of new romanceable characters, Helene and Victor. These unique individuals bring their own captivating stories and personalities to the Moonbury community, offering even more depth to your journey as you navigate the complexities of modern alchemy, relationships, and adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/e897e350b13cc99f5679ba572264e8bf99667a66.gif[/img]


[h2]New mini games[/h2]
One of our new mini-games allows you to join your faithful companion in a mushroom munching competition, where you must guide your loyal canine to devour delicious mushrooms while skillfully avoiding treacherous rocks. These engaging mini-games not only offer fun and challenges but also provide an opportunity to bond with your trusty companion, making your time in Moonbury even more delightful and memorable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/c651eb339e3eb0c904b83ee5b94d5b52410fcfa7.gif[/img]


[h2]Grow box[/h2]
While playing through a new tutorial, you'll be introduced to the Grow Box, a new object which will allow you to plant and grow your own material instead of having to forage it yourself!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/9da95693c53bec337f13f6662fbea42db632560e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 New Feature Added: Introducing 'Grow Box'
notes.content:
Hey Chemists! 

We come to you with exciting news! After implementing Japanese a couple of months ago, we have been brewing another update which is finally ready to be shared! We have added a new feature to the game! 🥳 

While playing through a new tutorial, you'll be introduced to the Grow Box, a new object which will allow you to plant and grow your own material instead of having to forage it yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/9da95693c53bec337f13f6662fbea42db632560e.gif[/img]

Don't worry, our lovely townsfolk will give you the full rundown of how exactly this awesome new feature works and how to get your hands on the Grow Box and the seeds to make it work! 

[i]See below for the full list of features and fixes coming with the new update: [/i]

[u][b]Version 1.14[/b][/u]

NEW FEATURES 
[list]
[*] Added Grow Box feature 
[*] Added Ranger Post tutorial & event 
[/list]
FIXES
[list]
[*] Fishing bar progress requirements adjustment
[*] Furniture pricing adjustment
[*] Fixed minor bug on world map
[*] Fixed fish weight display
[*] Fixed Godspeed Game's logo display within credits
[*] Fixed Olive's schedule
[/list]

We hope you have the best time trying out our new feature and we can't wait to hear what you think!

Happy growing, Chemists! 🌱

notes.title: Potion Permit Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Chemists! 

Thank you so much for your support and feedback this past year, we could not be happier with the love and passion you have shown and shared with us and all the residents of Moonbury.

Now, because it's the festive season, we come to you with a little surprise :present:
We are excited to share with you Potion Permit's roadmap for 2023!

There will be [b]four major updates[/b] planned throughout the year, and here's a taste of what's to come:
[list]
[*] Hotly requested, [b]new romance-able characters[/b] are on their way
[*] We'll be adding [b]additional languages[/b]
[*] There will be a [b]new mechanic[/b] and some [b]system changes[/b] to improve quality of life
[*] [b]New quests and arcade mini-games[/b] will also be added
[*] You'll be greeted in-game with a [b]new opening cinematic[/b]
[/list]
We hope you like what's coming to you this upcoming year and can't wait to hear what you think!

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year, Chemists! 🎉
